question: Akbar's revenue system "Zabt" was developed by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Todar Mal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Akbar's revenue system called "Zabt" was developed by Todar Mal, who was a finance minister in Akbar's court.**
 
• Todar Mal was known for his expertise in **revenue administration and taxation.**
 
• The system of** "Zabt"** involved fixing the** **revenue demand for a particular area, based on its productivity and potential, and collecting it directly from the cultivators.
 
• This system brought more revenue to the state and also reduced the** burden on the farmers**, as they were no longer exploited by the local landlords.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Todar Mal was also responsible for conducting a comprehensive land survey known as "Ain-i-Akbari", which provided detailed information about the land, its produce, and the revenue collected from it.**
